hypothesis: Applying the signed cyclic-index orbit to one non-anchor row at a time can preserve complete circle feasibility for the verified 5-violation coefficient vector, unlike the tested global relabels and row-0 anchor replacements, and may expose a lower-violation taxi potential.
rationale: The natural 20-variant matrix screen changed row 0 or all rows simultaneously and found no non-control circle-feasible variant. The upstream canonical hint permits index_matrix search and the signed absolute-index semantics define a deterministic local orbit for each of rows 1 through 4. Testing this orbit isolates whether the matrix's row interactions, rather than the anchor alone, are the restrictive mechanism.
expected_information_gain: Determines whether a broader but still structured one-row index_matrix catalogue contains any complete-circle-feasible non-control potential. A feasible variant justifies at most two exact taxi gates; an all-negative screen closes the practical local matrix-orbit route.
method: Load the locked upstream source and complete circle_k4_m6 metric. Hold the independently reproduced SEED_VECTORS[0] coefficient vector fixed. Evaluate the unchanged five-row matrix as a control, 24 variants obtained by applying each nonzero cyclic relabel shift 1..6 to one of rows 1..4, and four one-row sign flips. Compute each exact potential on all 1,001 nodes and count violations on all 6,006 circle edges. If any non-control variant scores zero, exact-score at most two such variants on the full taxi metric with eight streaming workers and independently reproduce any result below 3.
metric: screening: exact complete circle_k4_m6 violations_k; primary follow-up only for circle-feasible variants: exact full circle_taxi_k4_m6 violations_k
metric_relation_to_true_objective: Circle feasibility is only a necessary finite screen. The frozen target requires an exact full taxi result below 3, and any finite result remains incomplete evidence for the full conjecture.

variant_family: row-local cyclic relabels shifts 1..6 for rows 1..4

compute_budget.cpu: single circle-node evaluation process; optional eight bounded streaming workers for at most two circle-feasible taxi finalists
compute_budget.memory_intent: retain one node-potential vector per variant; no taxi cache

kill_condition: Stop after the complete variant list, at 700 seconds, or at a precise runtime failure. Run no taxi follow-up if every non-control variant violates the complete circle metric. Do not infer target progress from circle scores alone.

baseline_comparison.expected_relation: only a circle-feasible non-control matrix variant can enter the exact taxi gate; strict target progress requires violations_k < 3

previous_best_comparison.expected_relation: local row-orbit variation is the final bounded matrix screen before pausing this route

interpretation: Pending execution; no result is interpreted before the complete local-orbit matrix screen runs.
what_was_learned: Pending execution; the test asks whether row interactions in the canonical index matrix, rather than coefficient values, are the remaining restriction near the reported taxi result.
recommended_next_action: After execution, exact-score at most two circle-feasible non-control variants; if none are feasible, close the practical local index_matrix route and pause for a new global mechanism or runtime.
repetition_justification: This is a distinct one-row representation orbit after the prior screen tested only row-0 anchors and global relabels. It does not repeat coefficient, spread, fixed-edge, shortlist, or worker-count experiments.
